latestVersion.changelog:
PocketLens skill initial release:

- Enables uploading and auto-extraction of expense data from images of receipts, card statements, and payment screenshots.
- Supports manual transaction entry via natural language, including Korean and English.
- Provides tools to check PocketLens connection and API key status.
- Allows users to view and list their expense categories.
- Delivers spending summaries with category and card breakdowns by month.
- Offers card billing details, including payment due dates and unpaid amounts.
- Includes clear error messages for common API issues.
